text: With the launch of the Indigenous Affairs Office we see new capacity to have discussions around how the City works with Indigenous organizations to address protests and encampments lead by Indigenous community members. We are particularly concerned about protests and encampments in which community members voice their concerns in ways that create issues of health and safety for community members attempting to access services at Indigenous agencies. We are further concerned about the use of fires at these protests and encampments which are being called “sacred fires,” but do not meet the community standards and protocols to be classified as such. We propose that the Aboriginal Affairs Advisory Committee discuss the following: 1.
